newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept S&P 500 futures fall 15-pt initial limit.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept S&P 500 futures fall 15-pt initial limit.

text.p: September Standard and Poor's 500 futures at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange fell the initial 15-point downside limit on fallout from July National Association of Purchasing Management data.

September hit 942.95 after the data. If after 15 minutes of trading at this limit the market is locked limit-down, there will be a two-minute trading halt. Trade will then resume with a 30-point downside limit in effect.
